results.content: Months of immigration enforcement controversies have taken their toll, and new polling shows it could be a problem for Republicans heading into the midterms. About eight in 10 independent voters say U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement has used too much force in its nationwide operations, according to a poll from YouGov, which sampled 1,000 voters in late July. An earlier YouGov poll, which was conducted before the two shootings, found that most independents – 62% – believe ICE has gone too far.
